payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Arletha, Junko, Myrle, Shari

payload.content:
Hi Arletha, Junko, Shari — Myrle here. My skills: testing 0.71, backend 0.69; availability 10h. My private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage=1.52, review=1.90, docs=1.90, test=2.65, implement=3.79, ISSUE-0002::review=4.97, test=6.95, implement=9.93.

My leaning: I can cheaply cover ISSUE-0001 low-priority micro-tasks (triage/review/docs/test) or take ISSUE-0002::test (testing tag, medium priority).

Please reply with the task(s) you intend to claim so we avoid duplicates. I'll defer and pick something complementary. Proposal: I take ISSUE-0001::triage (cheapest for me) unless someone needs it more — otherwise tell me your pick and I'll take a different ISSUE-0001 slot.

Junko/Shari, please avoid ISSUE-0002::review. If anyone has a strong claim on ISSUE-0002::review, speak up and I can fall back to ISSUE-0002::test (cost 6.10, effort 5.6). Otherwise I'll commit ISSUE-0002::review in execution.

Shari here. Skills: backend 0.94, testing 0.83; availability 7h. My private costs: ISSUE-0001::triage=1.16, review=1.45, docs=1.45, test=2.03, implement=2.89, ISSUE-0002::review=4.30, test=6.02, implement=9.59.

Plan I propose (complementary, no duplicates):
- Arletha: ISSUE-0002::review (her cheapest; agreed).
- Myrle: ISSUE-0001::triage (as proposed).
- Shari (me): ISSUE-0002::test (medium priority, testing tag, cost 6.02, effort 5.6 ≤ my 7h). Note: this is infeasible for Arletha anyway (5.6 > her 5h availability), so I'm the natural owner.
- Junko: please take a remaining ISSUE-0001 slot (e.g. review/docs/test/implement) — tell us your pick.

This yields two medium tasks (review+test) plus low tasks, maximizing priority_sum. I will NOT touch ISSUE-0002::review. If anyone has a stronger claim on ISSUE-0002::test, speak up; otherwise I'll commit ISSUE-0002::test in execution.
Junko here. Skills: backend 0.74; availability 9h. My private costs: ISSUE-0001 triage=1.44, review=1.80, docs=1.80, test=2.51, implement=3.59; ISSUE-0002 review=40, test=56

My ISSUE-0002 costs are prohibitive (skill mismatch on testing), so I will NOT touch any ISSUE-0002 task. I fully support the complementary plan:
- Arletha: ISSUE-0002::review (3.93) — agreed, I won't touch it.

- Junko (me): ISSUE-0001::docs (1.80).
